e.en: On day 3, WhatsApp your coach: what did you notice from your food photos?

t.ms: Pelan 3 Hari: Makan Konsisten, Bukan Sekali-Sekala
t.en: 3-Day Plan: Eat Consistently, Not Just Sometimes

f.en: Check how much you really eat.

x.ms: Catat semua makanan dan minuman hari ini, termasuk snek dan air manis.
x.en: Write down all food and drinks today, including snacks and sweet drinks.

x.ms: Fikir balik minggu lepas: hari mana anda makan sikit atau skip makan?
x.en: Think back on last week: which days did you eat little or skip meals?

x.ms: Timbang badan pagi ini selepas tandas dan catat.
x.en: Weigh yourself this morning after the toilet and note it down.

f.ms: Makan lebih kerap, bukan banyak sekali gus.
f.en: Eat more often, not huge amounts at once.

x.ms: Makan 5 kali hari ini: 3 hidangan utama dan 2 snek. Set alarm kalau perlu.
x.en: Eat 5 times today: 3 main meals and 2 snacks. Set alarms if needed.

x.ms: Tambah tenaga dengan mudah: telur tambahan, kacang tanah, atau segelas susu penuh krim.
x.en: Add energy easily: an extra egg, peanuts, or a glass of full cream milk.

x.ms: Di mamak, pilih hidangan mengenyangkan seperti roti telur atau nasi lemak ayam dengan teh tarik.
x.en: At the mamak, pick filling meals like roti telur or nasi lemak ayam with teh tarik.

f.ms: Bagi badan sebab untuk bina otot.
f.en: Give your body a reason to build muscle.

x.ms: Buat 20 minit: squat, push-up, glute bridge dan row guna beg galas berisi buku.
x.en: Do 20 minutes: squats, push-ups, glute bridges and rows with a backpack full of books.

x.ms: Makan hidangan berprotein dalam 1-2 jam lepas latihan.
x.en: Eat a protein meal within 1-2 hours after training.

x.ms: Ulang 5 kali makan macam semalam.
x.en: Repeat the 5 eating times from yesterday.

e.ms: Hari ke-3, WhatsApp coach anda: berapa kali anda betul-betul makan setiap hari, dan mana yang paling susah?
e.en: On day 3, WhatsApp your coach: how many times did you really eat each day, and what was hardest?

t.ms: Pelan 3 Hari: Ada Pelan, Ada Sokongan
t.en: 3-Day Plan: A Clear Plan, Real Support

f.ms: Mula kecil dan tulis sebab anda.
f.en: Start small and write down your why.

x.ms: Tulis satu sebab kenapa anda nak naik berat. Simpan di nota telefon.
x.en: Write one reason why you want to gain weight. Save it in your phone notes.

x.ms: Pilih satu tabiat sahaja minggu ini: tambah satu snek setiap hari.
x.en: Pick just one habit this week: add one snack every day.

x.ms: Makan snek pertama hari ini: roti telur, pisang dengan kacang, atau segelas susu.
x.en: Have your first snack today: egg toast, banana with nuts, or a glass of milk.

x.ms: Malam ini, sediakan snek atau bekal untuk esok.
x.en: Tonight, prep a snack or bekal for tomorrow.

x.ms: Ulang snek tambahan hari ini dan tanda dalam kalendar.
x.en: Repeat the extra snack today and tick it on your calendar.

x.ms: Buat 10 minit squat ke kerusi dan push-up dinding, 2 set.
x.en: Do 10 minutes of chair squats and wall push-ups, 2 sets.

f.en: Get support, don't do it alone.

x.ms: Beritahu seorang kawan atau pasangan tentang matlamat anda.
x.en: Tell a friend or your partner about your goal.

x.ms: Tanda hari ini sebagai berjaya, walaupun tak sempurna.
x.en: Mark today as a win, even if it wasn't perfect.

x.ms: Catat satu perkara yang susah untuk dibincang dengan coach.
x.en: Note one thing that was hard to discuss with your coach.

e.ms: Hari ke-3, WhatsApp coach anda: apa yang berjaya, dan apa yang buat anda rasa nak berhenti?
e.en: On day 3, WhatsApp your coach: what worked, and what made you feel like quitting?

t.ms: Pelan 3 Hari: Naik ke Tahap Seterusnya
t.en: 3-Day Plan: Level Up Your Progress

f.ms: Semak protein dan latihan anda sekarang.
f.en: Check your protein and current training.

x.ms: Pastikan setiap hidangan ada protein sebesar tapak tangan: ayam, ikan, telur, daging atau tempe.
x.en: Make sure every meal has a palm-sized protein: chicken, fish, egg, meat or tempeh.

x.ms: Catat latihan anda sekarang: gerakan, set, ulangan dan berat.
x.en: Write down your current training: moves, sets, reps and weight.

x.ms: Timbang badan pagi ini dan ukur lilit lengan sebagai rujukan.
x.en: Weigh yourself this morning and measure your arm as a reference.

x.ms: Dalam latihan hari ini, tambah 1-2 ulangan atau sedikit berat dari biasa.
x.en: In today's workout, add 1-2 reps or a little more weight than usual.

x.ms: Tambah satu snek sebelum tidur: susu, roti telur atau yogurt.
x.en: Add one snack before bed: milk, egg toast or yogurt.

x.ms: Cuba tidur sekurang-kurangnya 7 jam untuk bantu otot pulih.
x.en: Aim for at least 7 hours of sleep to help your muscles recover.

x.ms: Rancang 3-4 sesi latihan minggu ini: squat, push-up, row dan hip hinge.
x.en: Plan 3-4 sessions this week: squats, push-ups, rows and hip hinges.

x.ms: Tambah setengah senduk nasi dalam satu hidangan hari ini.
x.en: Add half a scoop of rice to one meal today.

x.ms: Ambil gambar progres dari depan dan sisi sebagai rujukan.
x.en: Take progress photos from the front and side as a reference.

e.ms: Hari ke-3, WhatsApp coach anda: latihan mana yang anda tambah beban, dan macam mana rasanya?
e.en: On day 3, WhatsApp your coach: which exercise did you add weight to, and how did it feel?
